scientific_integrity: The classification is proved symbolically from the exact prime-factor formula for the arithmetic derivative. The bundled computation is finite regression evidence only and is not used to establish the unbounded theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to integers with at most two distinct prime divisors. The density corollary counts admissible prime supports for fixed p, not the resulting integers by magnitude. An obscure or unindexed equivalent observation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Two-prime-support classification of the arithmetic-derivative/totient equation
